arguments.code:
# Login and compute the most-liked song across all songs present in my Spotify playlist library
acct_pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in acct_pw if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login = apis.spotify.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login['access_token']

# Fetch all playlists (paginated)
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_playlists = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Unique song ids across playlists
unique_song_ids = sorted({sid for pl in all_playlists for sid in pl.get('song_ids', [])})
print('playlists_count', len(all_playlists))
print('unique_song_ids_count', len(unique_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids_sample', unique_song_ids[:20])

# Fetch like_count for each song and find max
song_like_info = []
max_like = None
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    like_count = s.get('like_count', None)
    title = s.get('title', None)
    artist_names = ', '.join([a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists', [])])
    song_like_info.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': title, 'artists': artist_names, 'like_count': like_count})
    if max_like is None or (like_count is not None and like_count > max_like):
        max_like = like_count

# Find all songs with max like_count (in case of ties)
max_songs = [x for x in song_like_info if x['like_count'] == max_like]
print('max_like_count', max_like)
print('max_songs_count', len(max_songs))
print('max_songs', max_songs[:10])

# Choose first by sorting title to make deterministic
max_songs_sorted = sorted(max_songs, key=lambda x: (x['title'] or '', x['artists'] or ''))
print('chosen_title', max_songs_sorted[0]['title'])
print('chosen_artists', max_songs_sorted[0]['artists'])
